title: Machine Learning for Invisible Dark Boson Searches at the Electron-Ion Collider
abstract: arXiv:2609.22484v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We investigate whether adding $t$, the positive magnitude of the squared nuclear four-momentum transfer, enables boosted decision trees (BDTs) to improve invisible-dark-boson selection relative to optimized rectangular cuts at the Electron-Ion Collider. We model coherent exclusive scalar and vector production at generator level in electron-gold collisions at 18 GeV by 100 GeV per nucleon. Both methods use identical weighted samples, inputs, preselection, and optimization objectives. Using only electron information, the BDT provided no consistent advantage over optimized cuts for signal selection across 11 masses for each boson type. When both methods also use $t$, the BDT distinguishes signal from background slightly better than optimized cuts at 10 GeV for both boson types. These results motivate further investigation of machine learning in EIC dark-boson searches through exclusive processes where $t$ can be reconstructed.

translated_title: 电子离子对撞机上不可见暗玻色子搜寻的机器学习研究
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在电子离子对撞机上，加入 $t$（核四动量转移平方的正值大小）是否能使提升决策树（BDT）相对于优化的矩形截断方法改善不可见暗玻色子的筛选效果。我们在18 GeV电子与每核子100 GeV的金核碰撞中，在产生器层面模拟了相干独占的标量和矢量玻色子产生过程。两种方法使用完全相同的加权样本、输入变量、预选择条件和优化目标。仅使用电子信息时，对于每种玻色子类型的11个质量点，BDT在信号选择上并未表现出相对于优化截断的一致优势。当两种方法都同时使用 $t$ 时，在10 GeV质量点处，BDT对两种玻色子类型的信号与背景区分能力略优于优化截断。这些结果激励了在EIC暗玻色子搜寻中，通过可重建 $t$ 的独占过程进一步探索机器学习方法的应用。
tldr: 在电子离子对撞机的不可见暗玻色子搜寻中，仅用电子信息时提升决策树并不比优化截断更有优势，但加入核四动量转移 $t$ 后，BDT在10 GeV质量点对信号与背景的区分能力略优于优化截断，为机器学习在该领域的应用提供了方向。
en_tdlr: In invisible dark boson searches at the Electron-Ion Collider, boosted decision trees show no consistent advantage over optimized cuts using only electron information, but incorporating the nuclear four-momentum transfer $t$ slightly improves signal-background separation at 10 GeV, motivating further machine learning studies in exclusive processes.
